raw_case_text: Routine investigations revealed Hb-13 g%, TLC-5800/mm3, and ESR-6 mm. Liver and renal function tests were normal. Mantoux test was positive with 18 x 20 mm induration. X-ray of the chest was within normal limits. The patient was HIV seronegative. Fine-needle aspiration of the lymph nodes revealed features of reactive hyperplasia, with stain for acid fast bacillus being negative.

objective.routine_investigations: Hemoglobin 13 g%, total leukocyte count (TLC) 5,800/mm3, erythrocyte sedimentation rate (ESR) 6 mm/hr. Liver and renal function tests were normal. Mantoux tuberculin skin test was positive with 18 x 20 mm induration. Chest radiograph was within normal limits. HIV serology was negative.
objective.advanced_workup: Fine-needle aspiration cytology (FNAC) of the lymph nodes revealed features of reactive hyperplasia, with negative staining for acid-fast bacilli.

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation:
Assessment: Clinical investigation for suspected tuberculous lymphadenopathy; lymph node fine-needle aspiration revealed reactive lymphoid hyperplasia without acid-fast bacilli, accompanied by a strongly positive Mantoux test (18 x 20 mm induration), normal chest radiography, and negative HIV serology.
Outcome: Fragment of published case record; subsequent diagnostic confirmation and management documented in companion case excerpts.
